items.question: Trong câu "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", từ "operate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", what does "operate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: operate /ˈɒp.ər.eɪt/ (động từ): vận hành, hoạt động. "Operating system" = hệ điều hành, phần mềm giúp máy tính vận hành; nghĩa khác: operate on (phẫu thuật).
items.explanationEn: operate /ˈɒp.ər.eɪt/ (verb): to work or run. "Operating system" is the software that makes a computer work; another sense is "operate on" (do surgery).

items.question: Trong câu "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", từ "foundational" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", what does "foundational" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: foundational /faʊnˈdeɪ.ʃən.əl/ (tính từ): nền tảng, cơ sở. "Foundational software" = phần mềm nền tảng mà mọi phần mềm khác dựa vào; danh từ: foundation (nền móng).
items.explanationEn: foundational /faʊnˈdeɪ.ʃən.əl/ (adjective): forming the base. "Foundational software" is the base other software depends on; noun: foundation.

items.question: Trong câu "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", từ "software" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", what does "software" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: software /ˈsɒft.weər/ (danh từ): phần mềm. Danh từ không đếm được: "a piece of software", không nói "softwares".
items.explanationEn: software /ˈsɒft.weər/ (noun): programs a computer runs. It is uncountable: say "a piece of software", not "softwares".

items.question: Trong câu "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", từ "manage" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", what does "manage" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: manage /ˈmæn.ɪdʒ/ (động từ): quản lý, điều phối. "Manages all hardware resources" = quản lý mọi tài nguyên phần cứng; nghĩa khác: "manage to do" (xoay xở làm được).
items.explanationEn: manage /ˈmæn.ɪdʒ/ (verb): to control and organize. "Manages all hardware resources" means controls them; another sense: "manage to do" (succeed in doing).

items.question: Trong câu "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", từ "hardware" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", what does "hardware" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hardware /ˈhɑːd.weər/ (danh từ): phần cứng. Hardware là các bộ phận vật lý như CPU, RAM, ổ đĩa; nghĩa gốc: đồ ngũ kim (búa, đinh...).
items.explanationEn: hardware /ˈhɑːd.weər/ (noun): physical computer parts. Hardware is the physical parts like CPU, RAM and disks; the original sense is metal tools and fittings.

items.question: Trong câu "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", từ "resource" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", what does "resource" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a supply that can be used
items.explanation: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (danh từ): tài nguyên. "Hardware resources" = tài nguyên phần cứng (CPU, RAM, ổ đĩa); cũng gặp "learning resources" (tài liệu học).
items.explanationEn: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (noun): a supply that can be used. "Hardware resources" are CPU, RAM and disk; you also see "learning resources" (study materials).

items.question: Trong câu "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", từ "provide" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", what does "provide" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: provide /prəˈvaɪd/ (động từ): cung cấp. Cấu trúc: provide something for someone / provide someone with something.
items.explanationEn: provide /prəˈvaɪd/ (verb): to give or supply. Patterns: provide something for someone / provide someone with something.

items.question: Trong câu "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", từ "environment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An operating system (OS) is the foundational software that manages all hardware resources and provides the environment for running other software.", what does "environment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: environment /ɪnˈvaɪ.rən.mənt/ (danh từ): môi trường (chạy phần mềm). "Provides the environment for running other software" = tạo môi trường để chạy phần mềm khác; nghĩa khác: môi trường tự nhiên.
items.explanationEn: environment /ɪnˈvaɪ.rən.mənt/ (noun): the setting where software runs. Here it is the setting in which programs run; another sense is the natural world.

items.question: Trong câu "A process is a running program.", từ "process" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A process is a running program.", what does "process" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: process /ˈprəʊ.ses/ (danh từ): tiến trình (chương trình đang chạy). Trong hệ điều hành, "process" = tiến trình; trong kinh doanh, "process" = quy trình.
items.explanationEn: process /ˈprəʊ.ses/ (noun): a program that is running. In an OS, a process is a running program; in business, a process is a series of steps.

items.question: Trong câu "The OS allocates CPU time to each process:", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The OS allocates CPU time to each process:", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to give out for a purpose
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (động từ): phân bổ, cấp phát. "Allocate CPU time/RAM" = cấp phát thời gian CPU/RAM; danh từ: allocation.
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæl.ə.keɪt/ (verb): to give out for a purpose. "Allocate CPU time/RAM" means hand it out to processes; noun: allocation.

items.question: Trong câu "Multi-tasking: running many processes at once (Chrome, Word, Spotify simultaneously).", từ "at once" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Multi-tasking: running many processes at once (Chrome, Word, Spotify simultaneously).", what does "at once" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at once /ət wʌns/ (cụm từ): cùng một lúc. "Running many processes at once" = chạy nhiều tiến trình cùng lúc; nghĩa khác: "Come here at once!" (ngay lập tức).
items.explanationEn: at once /ət wʌns/ (phrase): at the same time. "Running many processes at once" means at the same time; another sense is "immediately".

items.question: Trong câu "Multi-tasking: running many processes at once (Chrome, Word, Spotify simultaneously).", từ "simultaneously" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Multi-tasking: running many processes at once (Chrome, Word, Spotify simultaneously).", what does "simultaneously" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: simultaneously /ˌsɪm.əlˈteɪ.ni.əs.li/ (trạng từ): đồng thời. Đồng nghĩa với "at once"; tính từ: simultaneous (đồng thời).
items.explanationEn: simultaneously /ˌsɪm.əlˈteɪ.ni.əs.li/ (adverb): at the same time. A synonym of "at once"; adjective: simultaneous.

items.question: Trong câu "Scheduling: the CPU switches quickly between processes, creating the feeling of parallel execution.", từ "scheduling" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scheduling: the CPU switches quickly between processes, creating the feeling of parallel execution.", what does "scheduling" (noun) mean?
options: sự lập lịch (phân chia lượt chạy)
items.explanation: scheduling /ˈʃed.juː.lɪŋ/ (danh từ): sự lập lịch (phân chia lượt chạy). Trong hệ điều hành, scheduling quyết định tiến trình nào được dùng CPU; danh từ gốc: schedule (lịch trình).
items.explanationEn: scheduling /ˈʃed.juː.lɪŋ/ (noun): deciding which task runs when. In an OS, scheduling decides which process gets the CPU; base noun: schedule.

items.question: Trong câu "Scheduling: the CPU switches quickly between processes, creating the feeling of parallel execution.", từ "switch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scheduling: the CPU switches quickly between processes, creating the feeling of parallel execution.", what does "switch" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to change from one to another
items.explanation: switch /swɪtʃ/ (động từ): chuyển đổi (qua lại). "Switches between processes" = chuyển qua lại giữa các tiến trình; danh từ: a switch (công tắc).
items.explanationEn: switch /swɪtʃ/ (verb): to change from one to another. "Switches between processes" means moves from one to another; noun: a switch (a button that turns things on/off).

items.question: Trong câu "Scheduling: the CPU switches quickly between processes, creating the feeling of parallel execution.", từ "parallel" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scheduling: the CPU switches quickly between processes, creating the feeling of parallel execution.", what does "parallel" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: parallel /ˈpær.ə.lel/ (tính từ): song song. "Parallel execution" = thực thi song song; trái nghĩa: sequential (tuần tự).
items.explanationEn: parallel /ˈpær.ə.lel/ (adjective): happening side by side. "Parallel execution" means tasks run side by side; opposite: sequential.

items.question: Trong câu "Scheduling: the CPU switches quickly between processes, creating the feeling of parallel execution.", từ "execution" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scheduling: the CPU switches quickly between processes, creating the feeling of parallel execution.", what does "execution" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: execution /ˌek.sɪˈkjuː.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự thực thi. Động từ: execute (thực thi); nghĩa khác trong pháp luật: xử tử.
items.explanationEn: execution /ˌek.sɪˈkjuː.ʃən/ (noun): the running of a program. Verb: execute; in law, another sense is putting someone to death.

items.question: Trong câu "Process isolation: one process cannot interfere with the memory of another.", từ "isolation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Process isolation: one process cannot interfere with the memory of another.", what does "isolation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: isolation /ˌaɪ.səlˈeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự cô lập, tách biệt. "Process isolation" = cô lập tiến trình, không cho chúng đụng vào bộ nhớ của nhau; nghĩa khác: sự cô đơn.
items.explanationEn: isolation /ˌaɪ.səlˈeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): keeping things separate. "Process isolation" keeps processes apart; another sense is a feeling of loneliness.

items.question: Trong câu "Process isolation: one process cannot interfere with the memory of another.", từ "interfere with" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Process isolation: one process cannot interfere with the memory of another.", what does "interfere with" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to affect in a bad way
items.explanation: interfere with /ˌɪn.təˈfɪər wɪð/ (cụm từ): can thiệp, gây ảnh hưởng. "Interfere with the memory of another" = xâm phạm bộ nhớ của tiến trình khác; danh từ: interference (sự nhiễu, can thiệp).
items.explanationEn: interfere with /ˌɪn.təˈfɪər wɪð/ (phrase): to affect in a bad way. "Interfere with the memory of another" means disturb it; noun: interference.

items.question: Trong câu "Process isolation: one process cannot interfere with the memory of another.", từ "memory" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Process isolation: one process cannot interfere with the memory of another.", what does "memory" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: memory /ˈmem.ər.i/ (danh từ): bộ nhớ (máy tính). Trong máy tính, "memory" thường là RAM; nghĩa khác: kỷ niệm, trí nhớ của con người.
items.explanationEn: memory /ˈmem.ər.i/ (noun): storage for running data. In computing, memory usually means RAM; other senses are a recalled experience or the ability to remember.

items.question: Trong câu "Allocates RAM to each process as needed.", từ "as needed" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Allocates RAM to each process as needed.", what does "as needed" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: as needed /æz ˈniː.dɪd/ (cụm từ): khi cần, theo nhu cầu. "Allocates RAM as needed" = cấp RAM khi tiến trình cần; đồng nghĩa: "on demand".
items.explanationEn: as needed /æz ˈniː.dɪd/ (phrase): when required. "Allocates RAM as needed" means only when a process requires it; synonym: "on demand".

items.question: Trong câu "Reclaims RAM when a process ends.", từ "reclaim" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reclaims RAM when a process ends.", what does "reclaim" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reclaim /rɪˈkleɪm/ (động từ): thu hồi, lấy lại. "Reclaims RAM" = thu hồi RAM sau khi tiến trình kết thúc để dùng lại; cấu tạo: re- + claim.
items.explanationEn: reclaim /rɪˈkleɪm/ (verb): to take back for reuse. "Reclaims RAM" means getting it back after a process ends; formed from re- + claim.

items.question: Trong câu "Virtual Memory: uses the disk as virtual RAM when real RAM is full.", từ "virtual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Virtual Memory: uses the disk as virtual RAM when real RAM is full.", what does "virtual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: virtual /ˈvɜː.tʃu.əl/ (tính từ): ảo (mô phỏng). "Virtual memory" = bộ nhớ ảo dùng ổ đĩa giả làm RAM; nghĩa khác: "virtually" = gần như.
items.explanationEn: virtual /ˈvɜː.tʃu.əl/ (adjective): simulated by software. "Virtual memory" uses disk space to act like RAM; the adverb "virtually" also means "almost".

items.question: Trong câu "The OS organizes data on disk in a directory structure (folders/directories):", từ "organize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The OS organizes data on disk in a directory structure (folders/directories):", what does "organize" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: organize /ˈɔː.ɡən.aɪz/ (động từ): sắp xếp, tổ chức. "Organizes data on disk" = sắp xếp dữ liệu trên ổ đĩa; nghĩa khác: tổ chức một buổi tiệc, sự kiện.
items.explanationEn: organize /ˈɔː.ɡən.aɪz/ (verb): to arrange in order. "Organizes data on disk" means arranges it in order; another sense is to plan an event.

items.question: Trong câu "The OS organizes data on disk in a directory structure (folders/directories):", từ "directory" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The OS organizes data on disk in a directory structure (folders/directories):", what does "directory" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a list of names and numbers
items.explanation: directory /daɪˈrek.tər.i/ (danh từ): thư mục. "Directory structure" = cấu trúc thư mục; nghĩa khác: danh bạ điện thoại (telephone directory).
items.explanationEn: directory /daɪˈrek.tər.i/ (noun): a folder of files. "Directory structure" is the tree of folders; another sense is a telephone directory.

items.question: Trong câu "The OS organizes data on disk in a directory structure (folders/directories):", từ "structure" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The OS organizes data on disk in a directory structure (folders/directories):", what does "structure" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: structure /ˈstrʌk.tʃər/ (danh từ): cấu trúc. "Directory structure" = cách các thư mục lồng nhau; tính từ: structured (có cấu trúc).
items.explanationEn: structure /ˈstrʌk.tʃər/ (noun): the way parts are arranged. "Directory structure" is how folders are arranged; adjective: structured.

items.question: Trong câu "The OS uses drivers to communicate with hardware: graphics cards, keyboards, printers, etc.", từ "driver" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The OS uses drivers to communicate with hardware: graphics cards, keyboards, printers, etc.", what does "driver" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: driver /ˈdraɪ.vər/ (danh từ): trình điều khiển thiết bị. Trong máy tính, "driver" = phần mềm giúp OS nói chuyện với phần cứng; nghĩa thường: tài xế.
items.explanationEn: driver /ˈdraɪ.vər/ (noun): software that controls a device. In computing, a driver lets the OS talk to hardware; in everyday English, it is a person who drives.

items.question: Trong câu "The OS uses drivers to communicate with hardware: graphics cards, keyboards, printers, etc.", từ "communicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The OS uses drivers to communicate with hardware: graphics cards, keyboards, printers, etc.", what does "communicate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: communicate /kəˈmjuː.nɪ.keɪt/ (động từ): giao tiếp, trao đổi. "Communicate with hardware" = trao đổi tín hiệu với phần cứng; danh từ: communication.
items.explanationEn: communicate /kəˈmjuː.nɪ.keɪt/ (verb): to exchange information. "Communicate with hardware" means exchange signals with it; noun: communication.

items.question: Trong câu "Manages user accounts and access permissions.", từ "permission" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Manages user accounts and access permissions.", what does "permission" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: permission /pərˈmɪʃ.ən/ (danh từ): quyền (được làm gì). "Access permissions" = quyền truy cập (đọc, ghi, chạy tệp); động từ: permit.
items.explanationEn: permission /pərˈmɪʃ.ən/ (noun): the right to do something. "Access permissions" say who may read, write or run a file; verb: permit.

items.question: Trong câu "Isolates applications from one another.", từ "isolate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Isolates applications from one another.", what does "isolate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: isolate /ˈaɪ.sə.leɪt/ (động từ): cô lập, tách riêng. Cấu trúc: isolate A from B = tách A khỏi B; danh từ: isolation.
items.explanationEn: isolate /ˈaɪ.sə.leɪt/ (verb): to keep apart. Pattern: isolate A from B; noun: isolation.

items.question: Trong câu "Isolates applications from one another.", từ "application" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Isolates applications from one another.", what does "application" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: application /ˌæp.lɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): ứng dụng (phần mềm). Viết tắt là "app"; nghĩa khác: "job application" (đơn xin việc).
items.explanationEn: application /ˌæp.lɪˈkeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a software program. Often shortened to "app"; another sense is a formal request, as in "job application".

items.question: Trong câu "Built-in firewall.", từ "built-in" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Built-in firewall.", what does "built-in" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: built-in /ˌbɪltˈɪn/ (tính từ): tích hợp sẵn. "Built-in firewall" = tường lửa có sẵn trong hệ điều hành, không cần cài thêm.
items.explanationEn: built-in /ˌbɪltˈɪn/ (adjective): included from the start. "Built-in firewall" comes with the OS, so you do not install it separately.

items.question: Trong câu "A graphical interface — click, drag, drop.", từ "graphical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A graphical interface — click, drag, drop.", what does "graphical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: graphical /ˈɡræf.ɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): đồ họa, dùng hình ảnh. "Graphical User Interface (GUI)" = giao diện đồ họa với cửa sổ, nút bấm; danh từ: graphics.
items.explanationEn: graphical /ˈɡræf.ɪ.kəl/ (adjective): using pictures and icons. "Graphical User Interface" uses windows, icons and buttons; noun: graphics.

items.question: Trong câu "A graphical interface — click, drag, drop.", từ "interface" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A graphical interface — click, drag, drop.", what does "interface" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the part a user interacts with
items.explanation: interface /ˈɪn.tə.feɪs/ (danh từ): giao diện. "User interface" = giao diện người dùng; "API" là Application Programming Interface.
items.explanationEn: interface /ˈɪn.tə.feɪs/ (noun): the part a user interacts with. "User interface" is what users see and use; API stands for Application Programming Interface.

items.question: Trong câu "A graphical interface — click, drag, drop.", từ "drag" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A graphical interface — click, drag, drop.", what does "drag" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to move by holding the mouse
items.explanation: drag /dræɡ/ (động từ): kéo (bằng chuột). "Drag and drop" = kéo và thả; nghĩa thường: kéo lê một vật nặng.
items.explanationEn: drag /dræɡ/ (verb): to move by holding the mouse. "Drag and drop" moves items with the mouse; in everyday use it means pulling something heavy.

items.question: Trong câu "Easy to use, intuitive.", từ "intuitive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Easy to use, intuitive.", what does "intuitive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: intuitive /ɪnˈtjuː.ɪ.tɪv/ (tính từ): trực quan, dễ hiểu. "Intuitive interface" = giao diện dùng được ngay mà không cần học; danh từ: intuition (trực giác).
items.explanationEn: intuitive /ɪnˈtjuː.ɪ.tɪv/ (adjective): easy to use without learning. An intuitive interface can be used without training; noun: intuition.

items.question: Trong câu "A command-line interface — you type commands as text.", từ "command" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A command-line interface — you type commands as text.", what does "command" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: command /kəˈmɑːnd/ (danh từ): lệnh (máy tính). "Type commands" = gõ lệnh; "command line" = dòng lệnh. Nghĩa khác: mệnh lệnh của cấp trên.
items.explanationEn: command /kəˈmɑːnd/ (noun): an instruction to a computer. "Type commands" means entering instructions; another sense is an order from a superior.

items.question: Trong câu "A command-line interface — you type commands as text.", từ "type" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A command-line interface — you type commands as text.", what does "type" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: type /taɪp/ (động từ): gõ (bàn phím). Là động từ: gõ phím; là danh từ: loại, kiểu ("data type" = kiểu dữ liệu).
items.explanationEn: type /taɪp/ (verb): to write with a keyboard. As a verb it means using a keyboard; as a noun it means a kind ("data type").

items.question: Trong câu "Servers often have no GUI (to save resources).", từ "resource" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Servers often have no GUI (to save resources).", what does "resource" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: computing capacity like CPU or RAM
items.explanation: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (danh từ): tài nguyên (máy). "To save resources" = để tiết kiệm tài nguyên (CPU, RAM); GUI tốn tài nguyên nên máy chủ thường không cài.
items.explanationEn: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (noun): computing capacity like CPU or RAM. "To save resources" means using less CPU and RAM; a GUI costs resources, so servers often skip it.

items.question: Trong câu "Automation via scripts.", từ "automation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Automation via scripts.", what does "automation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: automation /ˌɔː.təˈmeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự tự động hóa. "Automation via scripts" = tự động hóa bằng script; động từ: automate.
items.explanationEn: automation /ˌɔː.təˈmeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): making tasks run by themselves. "Automation via scripts" means letting scripts do the work; verb: automate.

items.question: Trong câu "Automation via scripts.", từ "via" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Automation via scripts.", what does "via" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: via /ˈvaɪ.ə/ (giới từ): thông qua, bằng. "Via scripts" = thông qua script; cũng dùng cho tuyến đường: "fly to Paris via Dubai".
items.explanationEn: via /ˈvaɪ.ə/ (preposition): by means of. "Via scripts" means by using scripts; also for routes: "fly to Paris via Dubai".

items.question: Trong câu "Faster than a GUI for many technical tasks.", từ "technical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Faster than a GUI for many technical tasks.", what does "technical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: technical /ˈtek.nɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): thuộc về kỹ thuật. "Technical tasks" = công việc kỹ thuật; cụm: "technical skills" (kỹ năng chuyên môn).
items.explanationEn: technical /ˈtek.nɪ.kəl/ (adjective): relating to technology. "Technical tasks" are tasks needing technical knowledge; phrase: "technical skills".

items.question: Trong câu "Faster than a GUI for many technical tasks.", từ "task" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Faster than a GUI for many technical tasks.", what does "task" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a piece of work to do
items.explanation: task /tɑːsk/ (danh từ): nhiệm vụ, công việc. "Many technical tasks" = nhiều công việc kỹ thuật; cũng gặp trong "multi-tasking" (đa nhiệm).
items.explanationEn: task /tɑːsk/ (noun): a piece of work to do. "Many technical tasks" are jobs to do; also seen in "multi-tasking".

items.question: Trong câu "Thread: a smaller unit of execution within a process.", từ "thread" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Thread: a smaller unit of execution within a process.", what does "thread" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a unit of execution in a process
items.explanation: thread /θred/ (danh từ): luồng (thực thi). Trong lập trình, "thread" = luồng; nghĩa khác: sợi chỉ, hoặc một chuỗi thảo luận trên diễn đàn.
items.explanationEn: thread /θred/ (noun): a unit of execution in a process. In programming, a thread is a unit of execution; other senses are sewing thread or a discussion thread.

items.question: Trong câu "Thread: a smaller unit of execution within a process.", từ "unit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Thread: a smaller unit of execution within a process.", what does "unit" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a single part of a whole
items.explanation: unit /ˈjuː.nɪt/ (danh từ): đơn vị. "A unit of execution" = một đơn vị thực thi; cũng gặp "unit test" (kiểm thử đơn vị).
items.explanationEn: unit /ˈjuː.nɪt/ (noun): a single part of a whole. "A unit of execution" is one piece of running work; also seen in "unit test".

items.question: Trong câu "Thread: a smaller unit of execution within a process.", từ "within" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Thread: a smaller unit of execution within a process.", what does "within" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: within /wɪˈðɪn/ (giới từ): bên trong. "Within a process" = nằm bên trong một tiến trình; cũng dùng cho thời gian: "within 24 hours" (trong vòng 24 giờ).
items.explanationEn: within /wɪˈðɪn/ (preposition): inside. "Within a process" means inside it; also for time: "within 24 hours".

items.question: Trong câu "Example — Chrome: one Chrome process, but each tab is a thread (or a separate child process for isolation).", từ "separate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Example — Chrome: one Chrome process, but each tab is a thread (or a separate child process for isolation).", what does "separate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: separate /ˈsep.ər.ət/ (tính từ): riêng biệt. Tính từ đọc /ˈsep.ər.ət/, động từ đọc /ˈsep.ə.reɪt/ (tách ra).
items.explanationEn: separate /ˈsep.ər.ət/ (adjective): not joined to others. The adjective is /ˈsep.ər.ət/; the verb (to divide) is /ˈsep.ə.reɪt/.

items.question: Trong câu "Example — Chrome: one Chrome process, but each tab is a thread (or a separate child process for isolation).", từ "child process" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Example — Chrome: one Chrome process, but each tab is a thread (or a separate child process for isolation).", what does "child process" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: child process /ˈtʃaɪld ˌprəʊ.ses/ (cụm từ): tiến trình con. Tiến trình tạo ra nó gọi là "parent process" (tiến trình cha).
items.explanationEn: child process /ˈtʃaɪld ˌprəʊ.ses/ (phrase): a process started by another. The process that creates it is called the "parent process".

items.question: Trong câu "The kernel is the core of the OS — the part that runs with the highest privilege and interacts directly with the hardware:", từ "kernel" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The kernel is the core of the OS — the part that runs with the highest privilege and interacts directly with the hardware:", what does "kernel" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: kernel /ˈkɜː.nəl/ (danh từ): nhân hệ điều hành. "The kernel" = nhân của hệ điều hành; nghĩa gốc: hạt bên trong quả (a kernel of corn).
items.explanationEn: kernel /ˈkɜː.nəl/ (noun): the core of an OS. "The kernel" is the heart of the OS; the original sense is the seed inside a nut or grain.

items.question: Trong câu "The kernel is the core of the OS — the part that runs with the highest privilege and interacts directly with the hardware:", từ "core" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The kernel is the core of the OS — the part that runs with the highest privilege and interacts directly with the hardware:", what does "core" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a processing unit in a CPU
items.explanation: core /kɔːr/ (danh từ): phần cốt lõi. "The core of the OS" = phần lõi quan trọng nhất; nghĩa khác: "a 4-core CPU" (CPU 4 lõi).
items.explanationEn: core /kɔːr/ (noun): the central, most important part. "The core of the OS" is its central part; another sense: "a 4-core CPU".

items.question: Trong câu "The kernel is the core of the OS — the part that runs with the highest privilege and interacts directly with the hardware:", từ "privilege" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The kernel is the core of the OS — the part that runs with the highest privilege and interacts directly with the hardware:", what does "privilege" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: privilege /ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (danh từ): quyền hạn (trong hệ thống). "The highest privilege" = quyền cao nhất trong hệ thống; nghĩa khác: đặc ân, vinh dự.
items.explanationEn: privilege /ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (noun): a level of system rights. "The highest privilege" is the most system rights; another sense is a special honour.

items.question: Trong câu "The kernel is the core of the OS — the part that runs with the highest privilege and interacts directly with the hardware:", từ "interact" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The kernel is the core of the OS — the part that runs with the highest privilege and interacts directly with the hardware:", what does "interact" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: interact /ˌɪn.tərˈækt/ (động từ): tương tác. "Interacts directly with the hardware" = làm việc trực tiếp với phần cứng; danh từ: interaction.
items.explanationEn: interact /ˌɪn.tərˈækt/ (verb): to act on each other. "Interacts directly with the hardware" means works with it directly; noun: interaction.

items.question: Trong câu "User apps don't call hardware directly → they call through the kernel (system call).", từ "directly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "User apps don't call hardware directly → they call through the kernel (system call).", what does "directly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: directly /daɪˈrekt.li/ (trạng từ): trực tiếp. "Don't call hardware directly" = không gọi thẳng phần cứng mà phải đi qua kernel.
items.explanationEn: directly /daɪˈrekt.li/ (adverb): with nothing in between. "Don't call hardware directly" means apps must go through the kernel instead.

items.question: Trong câu "User apps don't call hardware directly → they call through the kernel (system call).", từ "system call" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "User apps don't call hardware directly → they call through the kernel (system call).", what does "system call" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a request from an app to the kernel
items.explanation: system call /ˈsɪs.təm kɔːl/ (cụm từ): lời gọi hệ thống. "System call" (syscall) = cách ứng dụng nhờ kernel làm việc với phần cứng, như đọc tệp.
items.explanationEn: system call /ˈsɪs.təm kɔːl/ (phrase): a request from an app to the kernel. A system call (syscall) is how an app asks the kernel to do hardware work, such as reading a file.

items.question: Trong câu "The kernel manages memory, CPU, and I/O at the lowest level.", từ "level" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The kernel manages memory, CPU, and I/O at the lowest level.", what does "level" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: level /ˈlev.əl/ (danh từ): tầng, mức (trừu tượng). "At the lowest level" = ở tầng thấp nhất, gần phần cứng nhất; đối lập: "high-level" (tầng cao).
items.explanationEn: level /ˈlev.əl/ (noun): a layer of abstraction. "At the lowest level" means closest to the hardware; the opposite is "high-level".

items.question: Trong câu "OS = the foundational software that manages resources.", từ "foundational" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "OS = the foundational software that manages resources.", what does "foundational" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: foundational /faʊnˈdeɪ.ʃən.əl/ (tính từ): làm nền móng. OS là "foundational software" vì mọi ứng dụng khác chạy trên nó.
items.explanationEn: foundational /faʊnˈdeɪ.ʃən.əl/ (adjective): serving as the base. The OS is "foundational software" because every other app runs on top of it.

items.question: Trong câu "OS = the foundational software that manages resources.", từ "resource" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "OS = the foundational software that manages resources.", what does "resource" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a system supply such as CPU or RAM
items.explanation: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (danh từ): tài nguyên hệ thống. Tóm tắt: OS quản lý "resources" = CPU, RAM, ổ đĩa, thiết bị.
items.explanationEn: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (noun): a system supply such as CPU or RAM. In the summary, the OS manages resources: CPU, RAM, disk and devices.

items.question: Trong câu "File System = how the OS organizes files.", từ "organize" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "File System = how the OS organizes files.", what does "organize" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put in a logical order
items.explanation: organize /ˈɔː.ɡən.aɪz/ (động từ): sắp xếp có trật tự. "How the OS organizes files" = cách OS sắp xếp tệp; danh từ: organization.
items.explanationEn: organize /ˈɔː.ɡən.aɪz/ (verb): to put in a logical order. "How the OS organizes files" is how it arranges them; noun: organization.

items.question: Trong câu "Driver = software that lets the OS communicate with hardware.", từ "communicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Driver = software that lets the OS communicate with hardware.", what does "communicate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: communicate /kəˈmjuː.nɪ.keɪt/ (động từ): liên lạc, trao đổi. Driver giúp OS "communicate with hardware"; cấu trúc: communicate with somebody/something.
items.explanationEn: communicate /kəˈmjuː.nɪ.keɪt/ (verb): to pass information. A driver lets the OS communicate with hardware; pattern: communicate with somebody/something.

items.question: Trong câu "Kernel = the core of the OS, with the highest privilege.", từ "core" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Kernel = the core of the OS, with the highest privilege.", what does "core" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: core /kɔːr/ (danh từ): trung tâm, cốt lõi. "The core of the OS" = phần trung tâm của OS; nghĩa đen: lõi quả táo (apple core).
items.explanationEn: core /kɔːr/ (noun): the most central part. "The core of the OS" is its centre; the literal sense is the middle of an apple.

items.question: Trong câu "Kernel = the core of the OS, with the highest privilege.", từ "privilege" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Kernel = the core of the OS, with the highest privilege.", what does "privilege" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a high level of access rights
items.explanation: privilege /ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (danh từ): quyền hạn cao. Kernel chạy "with the highest privilege" = với quyền cao nhất; cụm: "privileged mode".
items.explanationEn: privilege /ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (noun): a high level of access rights. The kernel runs "with the highest privilege"; related term: "privileged mode".
